title: Reinforced Generation of Combinatorial Structures: Hardness of Approximation

mechanism.domainTask: LLM-guided search for finite combinatorial constructions used in complexity-theoretic hardness proofs
mechanism.populationDetail: Appendix A says a genetic algorithm selects a high-scoring diverse subset of prior functions, but does not specify the maintained population organization.
mechanism.archiveDetail: High-scoring diverse prior functions are selected for prompting, but a distinct elite archive and its admission/eviction rules are not described.
mechanism.replacementDetail: The shown initial code snippet retains its best-scoring structure, but the paper cautions that AlphaEvolve searches generator code and this illustrative snippet does not establish the production system's population update policy.
mechanism.generationDetail: The paper describes syntactically valid code modifications and conditions the LLM on selected historical functions, but does not establish whether edits are broad, localized, or true multi-parent fusion.
mechanism.feedbackDetail: Numeric structure scores are paired with prior generator snippets and inform genetic selection and subsequent LLM proposals; invalid candidates also receive scores reflecting distance from constraint boundaries.
mechanism.parentSelectionDetail: Appendix A footnote 12 says not all prior functions are sent to the LLM; a genetic algorithm selects a subset by score and diversity, without specifying count or exact selection rule.
mechanism.outOfTaxonomy: LLM evolves executable generator/verifier code for finite mathematical constructions; verifier optimization itself is also performed through the search loop.

provenance.sourcePdf: papers/Reinforced Generation of Combinatorial Structures Hardness of Approximation.pdf
provenance.citationWarning: Existing survey citation is an application-level Mathematical Sciences mention. The paper confirms LLM-guided code generation and score feedback, but does not expose enough implementation detail to classify population/archive, parent-offspring relation, model configuration, or explicit exploration-exploitation control; avoid inferring these from general AlphaEvolve descriptions elsewhere.
